messages:
Vera: Quick flag: p99 for /v1/generate spiked after the canary roll at 14:12 UTC. p50/p95 fine.
Noah: Any per-stage breakdown? Console only has total and model_infer.
Vera: I sampled traces: routing + egress-proxy decode show heavy tail.
Li: We should avoid inferring stage p99 from independently sampled spans. Two paths: emit a compact per-request map at completion (ingress_ms,routing_ms,decode_ms,infer_ms,total_ms,rollout_id,sample_origin) OR ensure consistent sampling and collocation before quantile aggregation.
Noah: Map approach seems simplest for accurate p99 rollups and avoids tdigest cross-shard skew.
Vera: UX: add a "Per-stage percentiles" toggle in the latency pane and a small "coverage" badge; if coverage<80% show a warning. Also overlay rollout weight timeline.
Li: Edge: retries. Maps should be summed per logical request (not per attempt). Add attempt_count for debugging.
infra-bot: created TASK-9102 to track agent map RFC and TASK-9103 for rollout-overlay annotation.
Noah: Action: Li to draft RFC for agent fields + fallback behavior, Vera to spec console toggle. Plan: RFC by Tue, prototype API next week.
